packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/__init__.p.name: Sign-in package
packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/__init__.p.description: Marks the accounts and sign-in code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/account_au.name: Grant activation
packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/account_au.description: Activates a bounded account delegation once a trusted device has verified the owner.

packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/account_se.name: Password handling
packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/account_se.description: Normalizes an email and safely hashes and checks a password.

packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/devices.py.name: Device enrollment
packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/devices.py.description: Adds and verifies the owner's trusted devices using standard device sign-in.

packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/identity.p.name: Owner identity type
packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/identity.p.description: Defines who the signed-in owner is.

packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/owner_poli.name: Create the owner
packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/owner_poli.description: Sets up the owner account on first run.

packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/sessions.p.name: Session tokens
packages/auth/src/lonora_auth/sessions.p.description: Issues, reads and ends a sign-in session and checks its request token.
